policy: Preserve Greek statutory wording. Record EU/treaty status, national amendments and editorial interpretation separately. Link acceptance does not establish current force or applicability. A dependency is resolved only when the relevant provision, current text, and downstream procedure are evidenced.

dependencies.national_provisions: PD 106/2007; targeted Article 3(2) changes include Law 4540/2018 Article 32 and Law 5275/2026 Article 53; Law 4071/2012 Article 42 contains earlier targeted amendments.
evidence: Official Ministry-hosted English translation of PD 106/2007, used only as a partial article crosswalk.
Accepted original Greek Gazette locator and separately accepted targeted amendment links.
dependencies.note: The English translation identifies several corresponding provisions, but the Greek text controls and the translation crosswalk has not been checked article by article against the current Greek text. Article 53 of Law 5275/2026 changes specified Article 3(2) residence-document duration to five years from 6 February 2026; do not generalize this to every family member.

dependencies.instrument: Law 5226/2025 Article 28 together with PD 106/2007 Articles 22–24
dependencies.note: Article 28 applies the return procedure and judicial-protection framework supplementarily where it does not conflict with the more favourable PD 106/2007 provisions. Map authority, service, deadline, forum, suspensive effect and interim relief by decision type before use.

dependencies.instrument: Law 2690/1999 Administrative Procedure Code, Article 5 as replaced by Law 5143/2024 Article 59
dependencies.note: The accepted 1999 Gazette item is only the original issue locator, not current Article 5 wording. Article 59 is a targeted amendment, not a consolidated Code. Verify the current official text, scope, exceptions, response period and remedy.

C-61/22 declared Regulation 2019/1157 invalid while maintaining its effects until replacement. Regulation 2025/1208 entered into force on 10 July 2025. Its 3 August 2026 transition date has passed for the specified older cards; confirm the precise card class/transition rule and inspect a current Greek issued-card specimen. No Greek specimen or conformity evidence is accepted here.

The Regulation simplifies formalities only for listed public documents and does not determine substantive legal effect or create a universal translation/legalisation exemption. Identify document type and relevant national receiving authority before applying it.

dependencies.instrument: Agreement on the European Economic Area
dependencies.note: Keep treaty text distinct from evidence of party status and from Greece-specific national implementation. No Greek family-category, procedure or remedy crosswalk is accepted.

dependencies.instrument: Agreement on the free movement of persons between the European Community and Switzerland
dependencies.note: Do not merge this route with Directive 2004/38 or assume every family category and procedural entitlement is identical. No Greek implementation or remedy map is accepted.

dependencies.instrument: Agreement on the withdrawal of the United Kingdom from the European Union
dependencies.note: Keep Withdrawal Agreement beneficiaries and evidence of their status separate from Directive 2004/38 and general third-country routes. No complete Greek procedure or remedy map is accepted.
